verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent service lists its own address on public records [docs-7] and promises to scan and upload received documents to your account with email alerts and reminders [docs-4, docs-9]. It also promises an alert "as soon as official mail arrives" [docs-3]. However, the evidence never states that service of process is accepted at a staffed physical street office, nor that scanning happens the same day it is received. Missing for 10: explicit same-day scanning commitment, confirmation that the registered address is a staffed physical office rather than a mail drop, and independent or hands-on corroboration of turnaround time.
